what: A 14px accent-color ball sticks to the mouse position, and six dots (12→4.5px, opacity .85→.16) follow the previous dot in turn to draw a tail. Where a verb is attached (data-fx-cursor-ball="verb: view") on hover the ball folds away and a verb label like ‹View →› appears, while pressed the label squashes to .82×.74
ease: Each tail dot approaches by .42 every frame · press power2.out .18s · ball fold cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1) .34s

options.data-fx-cursor-ball (on the inner elemen: verb: see — the verb that floats above it · tone: dark (on the contrast stage — text in the contrast text color), accent (ball and text in ink)
options.stretch: Maximum amount the ball stretches in the direction of fast movement (from speed 30px/s, adding 1 at 2600px/s), default 0 (off). The original site uses 0.55
options.hop: Height (px) the ball jumps on press — jumps in .44s, squashes, and settles with two small bounces. Default 0 (off). Original 46
options.trail: Exponential easing speed (per second) at which tail dots follow the dot ahead. Leave empty for .42 per frame. Original 30
options.lag: Exponential interpolation speed (per second) at which verb letters follow. Leave empty for instant. Original 20

use: … …

from.where: shared.js initCursor — original value is stretch: 0.55; hop: 46; trail: 30; lag: 20 (ball speed interpolation 18/s). Verbs appear only at data-cursor spots, and per-verb letter motions (drop · float · pen · shake · release · stick) are in the site css

note: Runs only inside the attached element (the whole page if body). Of the original’s per-verb motions (letters dropping · floating · pen · shaking), only the verb text swap and a press squash are done, like the rebuild · if the options are left empty, the old behavior stays as is
